title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 4

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the manual lesson take place?
tasks.audioText: The technical documentation tutor will review manual structure on Wednesday at eleven. Students should bring the sample maintenance manual and meet in the library training room. The session will identify applicability information, task references and revision details. The tutor will explain why users must confirm that a document applies to the equipment and configuration being discussed.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which manual should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The technical documentation tutor will review manual structure on Wednesday at eleven. Students should bring the sample maintenance manual and meet in the library training room. The session will identify applicability information, task references and revision details. The tutor will explain why users must confirm that a document applies to the equipment and configuration being discussed.

tasks.prompt: A technical manual contains information for a defined product, model or configuration. Before using a procedure or reference, a reader should check the document identifier, applicability information and revision status. Similar models may have different components or requirements. If the manual does not clearly apply, the user should ask the responsible documentation or engineering team for confirmation. Reading 1. What should a reader check before using a manual reference?
options: Document identifier, applicability information and revision status
Supplier address, purchase price and delivery date
Training location, lesson time and group number
Technician name, shift preference and annual leave

tasks.prompt: Why may similar models require different documentation?
options: Because similar models always use identical components
Because the revision date is the only difference between models
Because models may have different components or requirements
Because a manual can be used for any model in the same product family

tasks.prompt: The manual applicability ___ before the reference is used.
Choose TWO checks needed before using a technical manual.
options: The colour of the document cover

tasks.prompt: Information that states which model or configuration a document applies to is its ___.
You are not sure that a manual applies to the model. What should you ask?
options: I will use it because the title looks similar.
Could the documentation team confirm that this revision applies to the equipment model?
The model number is not important.
I will change the applicability statement.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of technical manual use in a logical order.
options: Identify the equipment model and configuration
correctOrder: Identify the equipment model and configuration

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining how to check that a technical manual is applicable and current before using it.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total. Score each criterion 0–2: (1) Applicability — 2: explains checking equipment identity, model/configuration and task applicability; 1: partial check; 0: absent. (2) Document control — 2: checks document identifier, current revision and approval status; 1: mentions some; 0: absent. (3) Verification — 2: explains using the controlled source and seeking confirmation if uncertain; 1: partial; 0: absent or recommends relying on an uncontrolled copy. (4) English — 2: clear sequence and accurate technical-publication vocabulary; 1: errors but meaning clear; 0: meaning frequently unclear.
